description: This file contains static helper methods for analyzing and handling serialization-related attributes within the Orleans project, specifically in the context of code analysis using Roslyn. It defines utility methods to determine if types should be serialized, analyze type declarations for annotated members, and manage serialization attributes.

classes.name: SerializationAttributesHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to analyze and process serialization attributes on C# type declarations within the Orleans codebase.

methods.name: ShouldGenerateSerializer
methods.description: Determines if a given type declaration should have a serializer generated, based on its attributes and whether it is static.

methods.name: AnalyzeTypeDeclaration
methods.description: Analyzes a type declaration syntax node to identify members annotated for serialization and assign IDs, while counting constructors marked for serialization.
